metadata.description: Skills for explaining and replaying how software systems and AI workflows work, as interactive pages.

plugins.name: interactive-architecture-explainer
plugins.description: Build an interactive architecture or workflow explainer page that a non-builder can review: one diagram, scenario buttons that play a path step by step, a plain-language side panel, and the decisions to make.

plugins.name: workflow-trace-replay
plugins.description: Record real runs of an AI or agent workflow and build a replay page: the workflow as a state machine, every call on a timeline, a funnel, and a pop-up with exactly what each model call was sent and returned.
